title: Program search filters
intro: Start with the region and program type. Additional filters are optional.
emptyHint: Leave every filter empty to include all programs.

region.label: Program region
region.help: Choose a region to make the program list shorter. Already selected programs from other regions are kept in the list.

more.trigger: More filters: school day, PIE, PACE, fees and other characteristics
more.hint: Leave a filter empty when that characteristic is not essential for you.

specialty.label: Specialized area
specialty.help: Leave empty to include all specialized areas.

gender.label: Gender composition
gender.help: Leave empty to include mixed, boys-only, and girls-only programs.

schoolDay.label: School day
schoolDay.help: Leave empty to include full-day, morning, and afternoon programs.

rurality.label: Rurality
rurality.help: Leave empty to include both urban and rural schools.

pace.label: PACE program
pace.help: Leave empty to include schools with and without PACE.

pie.label: PIE integration program
pie.help: Leave empty to include schools with and without PIE.

monthlyFee.label: Monthly fee
monthlyFee.help: Leave empty to include every monthly-fee category.

enrollmentFee.label: Enrollment fee
enrollmentFee.help: Leave empty to include every enrollment-fee category.

religious.label: Religious orientation
religious.help: Leave empty to include every orientation.

keptOutside: Existing selected program(s) outside the current filters are also kept available: {n}.

search.title: Search and add programs
search.label: Search for a program
search.help: Search by province, commune and program.
search.error: The program list could not be loaded.
search.truncated: Showing the first {n} results. Narrow the search or the filters.

details.title: Program details
details.notFound: This program is no longer available in the loaded data.
details.error: The program details could not be loaded.
